Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The Afghanistan players are out on the field and they are followed by the two Zimbabwe openers, Tinashe Kamunhukamwe and Tinashe Kamunhukamwe. Naveen-ul-Haq  to start with the ball. Here we go...
... THE CHASE BEGINS ...

So 194 is what Zimbabawe need to keep this series alive. Though it is a good pitch to bat on, they will need to be at their best if they are to take on the Afghanistan spinners. Afghanistan will hope the bowlers can once again follow up on the job done by the batsmen and seal the series. Join us for the chase in a while.

The star of the show with the bat, Mohammad Nabi is caught for a chat. He says that he enjoyed batting after the platform given by the batsmen early on. He says that the spinners were easy to hit and he enjoyed it. Mentions that the bat was heavy which is good for the spinners and not for a fast bowler so he changed it. He mentions that the score looks good one and he hopes the bowlers express themselves today.

Another tough day with the ball for Zimbabwe! They started off poorly in the previous game but today they were strong in the Powerplay but lost the plot in the death. It was not an easy pitch to bowl on to be fair to the tourists' bowlers. Blessing Muzarabani scalped two wickets but was very expensive, going for 44 in his 4.  Ryan Burl was excellent in his 2 overs going for just 7 and picking up a wicket as well. Richard Ngarava was fantastic in his first three overs but was punished in the final over but he still finished with respectable figures of 1/31. Tiripano was the other bowler to pick a wicket but he was smashed for 30 in his 2.

Opting to bat, unlike the last game, Afghanistan did not get off to a flying opening start. They lost Man of the Match from the last game,  Rahmanullah Gurbaz early. Ghani and Karim Janat though put the hosts in a good spot with their 102-run stand. The former missed out on his fifty by a run but Janat got it. He though could not last long after that. It looked like the wheels were coming off as Zadran was struggling as well. Nabi though with his blistering 40 off just 15 balls got them back on track. Solid finish from Asghar Afghan and Rashid Khan ensured the hosts finished with a total of over 190!

70 from the last 5 overs and once again Afghanistan have done the job with the bat. A poor showing once again with the ball by Zimbabwe. They were good in the death in the last game but today they were taken to the cleaners at the death.
Full toss on middle, Khan whips it to mid-wcket for a single. AFGHANISTAN END WITH A SCORE OF 193/5!
FOUR! Useful runs! Full and wide outside off, Khan shuffles across his off stump before carving it through point for a boundary.
Full yorker around of, Afghan squeezes it to mid-wicket off the toe-end off the bat for a single.
Yorker outside off, Afghan plays it back to the bowler.
SIX! That is monstrous! Slower and outside off, Afghan get it from outside off and deposits it over long on for a huge it.
FOUR! Full use of the Free Hit there! Full and outside off, Afghan hangs on the back foot before pulling it to mid-wicket for a boundary.

Short of good length around off, Rashid looks to heave it over the leg side but inside edges it onto the pads. The batsmen steal a single. No ball called as Ngarava oversteps there. Free Hit coming up.
Full and on middle, whipped to mid-wicket for a single.
Slower back of a length ball around off, Rashid slices it to extra cover where Williams leaps but the ball goes past him. A couple taken.
Yorker around leg, yields almost another wicket as Afghan squeezes it to short fine leg for a single.
Afghanistan superstar replaces the President! Rashid Khan walks out to bat in his 50th T20I!

OUT! CAUGHT! Nabi departs but not before playing a cameo. Slower short ball around off, Nabi goes for the pull but not to his liking as he finds the deep mid-wicket fielder there to perfection. Tarisai Musakanda there takes the catch.
SIX! Sent into the stands! Full and in the slot on middle, Nabi hoicks it over long on for a maximum.

Full and angled on the pads, Afghan clips it to short fine leg and takes a single as the fielder misses his shy at the striker's end. Afghan would be gutted as he could have got a boundary if the ball would have been away from the fielder there.
FOUR! Change of bat does it for Nabi! Full and outside off, Nabi stays on the back foot before cutting it through point to get a boundary. 10 runs off the 18th over.
Another slower short ball from Ngarava and Afghan swivels as he pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and straight on middle, Nabi drives it down to long off for a single.
FOUR! Powerful blow! Slower ball around off, Nabi waits for the ball to come before swatting it away to wide long on for a boundary
Slower short ball around off, Nabi goes for the pull but chops it back to the keeper who fields it by going to his left.
Full and wide outside off, Nabi drives it to covers.
Who comes out to bat now? It is Afghanistan's skipper, Asghar Afghan who comes out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Muzarabani strikes and Zadran departs. It was a good battle between the two and it is the Zimbabwean pacer who trumps it. Full on off, Zadran looks to go over long off but the ball is not full enough. He does not get it right of the middle and ends up finding Ryan Burl at long off. He does well to take the catch and also ensure he is inside the ropes.
FOUR! Good shot, well timed! Short ball on off, Zadran pulls it away from fine leg and gets a boundary.
DROPPED! A very tough chance as the ball was travelling at the speed of knots. Full on off, Zadran hits it very hard but uppishly back to Muzarabani. He gets his hands to it but cannot hold onto it.
Yorker length outside off. It is wide but inside the tramline. Zadran looks to hit it through point but misses.
Full around off, Nabi drives it to sweeper cover for a run.
WIDE! Muzarabani misses his line and bowls one down the leg side. Nabi looks to flick but misses.
Just a single off the Free Hit. Blessing goes wide outside off. Zadran stretches and cuts but very close to point. Just a single.
NO BALL! Blessing Muzarabani has overstepped. Free Hit to follow! Good length ball on off, Zadran punches it but finds cover.

SIX! 23 runs off the over! Expensive over of the match so far. Loopy around off, Nabi is quick to pounce on the ball and then send it up and over mid-wicket for a biggie. The fielder from long on ran to his right but could manage just fingertips on it.
Full on off, turned to mid-wicket for a single.

EDGED BUT SHORT! Another fuller one from Mavuta and Nabi looks to go over the fence again but this time he gets a top edge on it. The ball flies towards third man. The short third man fielder moves to his left to catch but he cannot as the ball goes towards the fence. He somehow fields it inside the ropes but not before the batsmen take three runs.
SIX! That is huge! Fuller and outside off, Nabi gets it from there and sends it over the ropes at long on for another biggie.
SIX! Nabi goes big and gets the desired result. Flatter and around off, Nabi slogs it in the gap between long on and mid-wicket as the ball sails over them.
Flatter and outside off, Zadran slaps it through covers where Sean Williams gets a hand to it. Just a single.
Change in bowling. Brandon Mavuta is back on! 0/19 from his 2 overs.
Quicker around off, eased down the ground for a single by Zadran.
Full and on leg, Zadran goes for the reverse sweep but ends up playing it to covers.
Again on the shorter side, Nabi plays it into the pocket at mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker and shorter on middle, Nabi whips it across to mid-wicket for a brace.
Full on off, Nabi looks to nudge it to the leg side but ends up getting a soft leading edge to the off side.
President time! Mohammad Nabi strides out to bat now.

OUT! TIMBER! Burl strikes and the dangerous Janat heads back. Tossed up on off, Janat goes for the slog again but is early into the shot as the ball is slow to arrive. He misses it and sees his stumps castled.

In the air... DROPPED SHORT! Good effort in the deep though! Flat and outside off, Janat slogs it high and towards deep mid-wicket the fielder there comes running to the ball and  it drops short of him. A single taken.
An appeal but nothing from the umpire. Full and on leg, Janat looks to slog it away but is beaten to get hit on the pads. Raza puts up an appeal and the umpire rejects it.
Darted on middle, Zadran turns it towards mid-wicket and rotates the strike with a single.
Pushed through on off, Zadran plays it to the off side.
Flat and outside off, Zadran cuts it to deep point for two runs.
Flat and outside off, Janat looks to slog it away but ends up playing it down to long off for a single.
Raza is back! 0/21 from his 2 overs so far.
Flatter and outside off, punched down to long on for a single by Janat.
Short and wide cut straight to backward point.
Flatter and outside off, Janat leans into the shot and plays it to covers.
On leg, turned towards fine leg for a single.
Full and on leg, Zadran looks to nudge it down the leg side but is beaten to get hit on the pads. Burl ask the question  to the umpire but he shakes his head.
Tossed up on off, Janat drives it through covers for a single to bring up his maiden T20I fifty in just 31 balls.
Najibullah Zadran walks out to bat! Also, Ryan Burl is introduced into the attack.

OUT! CAUGHT! Usman Ghani is disappointed as he fall for 49! Good smart catch from Blessing Muzarabani. Length and angled on leg, Ghani looks to flick it to the leg side but plays it towards short fine leg. Muzarabani dives to his right and takes the catch. A wicket against the run of play for Zimbabwe. Tiripano has something to cheer in the end.
FOUR! Cut away! Short and wide outside off, Ghani slices it off the back foot through cover-point and gets a boundary. He moves onto 49 too. 100-run stand is up between these two.
WIDE! Tiripano tries to bowl it well wide outside off but this time he ends up bowling past the tramline. Wide called.
Slower and outside off, Janat nudges it to the leg side for a single. He moves on to 49!
Length ball on middle, Ghani clips it to mid-wicket and takes a single.
FOUR!  Poor bowling from Tiripano. On the pads this time, Ghani clips it past short fine leg, Wesley Madhevere  in the deep does well but cannot prevent the boundary there.
SIX! Slogged away! Slower ball outside off, Ghani fetches it from there and deposits it over square leg for a six. 100-up for Afghanistan.
A single to keep the strike now. Tossed up on middle, Ghani plays it to long off for a single.
FOUR! Nicely done! Tossed up around off, Ghani squeezes it through cover-point and finds the fence this time.
Very full and around off, Janat strokes it past the bowler for a single.
Full on middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Slower on middle, Janat looks to drive but ends up getting an inside edge which goes past the bowler and towards mid off for a single.
Tossed up on off, Janat cuts but finds cover-point.
On middle, turned to square leg for a couple of runs.
Beaten! Pushed through outside off, Ghani goes for the square cut again but is beaten by the extra bounce.
Short and wide outside off, Ghani backs away as he looks to cut but finds backward point this time.
Floated around middle, Janat drives it down to long on for a run.
Good comeback from the bowler. Darts one on leg, Ghani plays it to square leg for a single.
SIX! In the air...It sails over! Floated outside off, Ghani makes room gets to the ball and then flat bats it over long on for half a dozen.
Change in bowling. Brandon Mavuta is back from the other end.
Slower around off, Janat plays it back to the bowler.
Flighted around middle, nudged to the leg side for a single.
Slower and wider outside off, Ghani drives but finds extra cover this time.
Tosses outside off, Ghani pushes it to the off side.
FOUR! This time he gets the gap! Floated around off, Ghani makes room and slashes it through covers and gets a boundary this time.
Floated around off, Ghani plays it to covers.
Change in bowling. The skipper has introduced himself into the attack. Sean Williams to roll his arm over.

Good running! Putting pressure on the fielders there. Length and around off, Janat flicks it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single as the fielder comes running towards the ball but he fails to pick it cleanly as the batsmen take another run.
SIX! Shot! Full and in the slot as Janat lofts it easily over the bowler's head and into the fence at long off for a biggie.
WIDE! Short and down leg, Janat leaves it. Wide called.
Full on  off, Ghani plays it to point and takes a single.
Another good length delivery around off, Ghani looks to flick but ends up getting a soft leading edge to covers. He looks for a single but is sent back by his partner.
Good length and around middle, Ghani clips it to mid-wicket and takes a couple of runs now.
Short of good length and around off, Janat plays it through the off side for a single to bring up the 50-run stand between these two.
Flatter and outside off, Janat cuts it in front of point for a single. 9 from the over.
Fuller around off, squeezed to point for a run.
Pushed through on middle, pushed to long on for a single.
Floated around off, driven down to long off past the bowler for a single.
Floated on off, Ghani punches it through covers and gets a brace.
Floated on off, Janat pushes it to cover for one.
WIDE! False start for Mavuta. Bowls one down the leg side, Janat looks to flick but misses. The keeper fails to gather it and they take an extra run.
Change in bowling. Brandon Mavuta is into the attack.

SIX! Powerfully struck! Again a short one and Janat frees his arms and this time it is even better as he clears the fence on the full for a biggie. 20 runs off the over a good one for Afghanistan to finish the Powerplay.  Afghanistan are 49/1 at the end of the Powerplay.
FOUR! Blessing does not learn from his mistake! He goes short and wide outside off, Janat slashes at it and fetches a boundary at point.
Short of good length and outside off, Karim looks to smash it away but the extra bounce takes the ball past the outside edge as the keeper takes it near his eyes.
FOUR! Hammered away! Short and wider outside off, Janat waits for it and then cuts it powerfully through point for a boundary.
Length and outside off, Janat cuts it but gets an under edge back to the keeper who takes it on the bounce.
SIX! That's gone down the miles! Length and around off, in  the arc for Janat as he lofts it up and over long on for a maximum.
Slower and on a length around middle, whacked away to the on side for a single.
Full on off, driven down to mid off.
Short of good length and around off, Ghani looks to turn it to the leg side as he closes the bat face early. The ball takes the leading edge and runs down to third man for a single.
Beaten! Short of good length and angled outside off, Ghani looks to cut it off the back foo but again the extra bounce does him in as he gets beaten on the outside edge.
Bumper! Short of good length, the ball rises nicely as Ghani sits under it.
Good length and around off, Ghani hops and defends it to the leg side.
Richard Ngarava  is back on.
Slower ball to finish the over as Janat looks to cut it but ends up toe-ending it to covers.
BEATEN! Good length and outside off, Janat looks to go for a wild slash but is beaten completely.
Good length ball outside off, Ghani rides the bounce as he plays it to third man for a single.
FOUR! Pulled away! Slightly short in length and Ghani gets on top of the bounce before pulling it past the short fine leg fielder and into the fence behind for a boundary.
Length ball on off, pushed to covers.

Confusion between the batsmen. A possibility of a wicket for Zimbabwe but they don't take. Full and around off, Ghani pushes the ball at covers and comes running down the wicket. He is sent back by Janat. He turns and looks to go back. THe fielder from covers takes the ball but misses his shy at the striker's end.
Blessing Muzarabani  is into the attack now.
Quicker on leg, Ghani turns it to mid-wicket and takes a single to retain the strike for the next over.
Darted on middle, Janat pushes it to long on for a single.
FOUR! Cut away! Flatter and outside off, Janat cuts it uppishly and over covers as he finds the fence again.
Floated around midlde, pushed back to the bowler.
SIX! Straight as an arrow! Floated ball around off, Janat frees his arms and lofts it high and handsome over long off for a biggie. First one of the innings.
Tossed up ball on off, Janat plays it to covers.
On middle, played to mid-wicket. A single and a wicket off the over.
Another length ball around off, Janat looks to play it off the back foot but gets an outside edge as the ball runs down to third man. A single taken.
Short and outside off, Janat cuts but finds Ryan Burl to perfection at point.
Good length and around off, Janat punches the ball to covers.
Who comes out to bat now? Karim Janat is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Gurbaz goes early. It is Richard Ngarava who strikes and joy for Zimbabwe. Good length and angled across off, Gurbaz looks to punch it on the up through the off side but the extra bounce does him in as the outside edge is found. Richmond Mutumbami behind the stumps takes the catch. Early blow for Afghanistan.
Good length and around off, Gurbaz blocks it right under his eyes.
Who will share the new ball? It will be Richard Ngarava!
On middle, turned to the leg side for a single. 9 runs from the first over.
Flatter and ooutside off, Gurbaz looks to cut it through point but the ball keeps low to beat him all ends up.
FOUR! Back to back hits! Full and around off, Gurbaz comes down the ground and lofts it over the bowler and for a one-bounce into the fence at long off for a boundary.
FOUR! Gurbaz and Afghanistan are up and running. Full and around off, Gurbaz makes room and crashes it through covers for a boundary.
Floated on off, Gurbaz plays it back to the bowler this time.
Raza starts with a Floated ball around off, Gurbaz blocks it out off the front foot.

We are all set to begin the game as the two Afghanistan openers, Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Usman Ghani walk out to the middle. The Zimbabwe players are out on the field too as they are ready to begin. Sikandar Raza to start with the ball. Here we go...

Zimbabwe skipper, Sean Williams, says that he was looking to bat first as the wicket looks fantastic and they wanted to put pressure by putting runs on the board. Tells they will need to execute now. Williams says the extras were costly and feels lines and lengths will be crucial. Adds that they have learned from the last game. Tells had they taken the catch the contest might have been closer. Sean Williams informs they are unchanged from the last game.

Afghanistan captain, Asghar Afghan says that they will bat first. He says that the wicket is similar to the first game and they again want to bat and put up a score. He praises the partnership between Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Karim Janat in the first T20I. He says that they would look to put up a score of around 150-16 so that their bowlers can have something to bowl at. He ends by saying that they are playing the same team from the previous game.

PITCH REPORT - Athar Ali Khan is the pitch analyst for the day. Athar Ali Khan says the surface looks like a very good batting surface. Tells this is a new and fresh pitch that has not been used. Tells it is a very dry surface. Athar Ali Khan says there will be problems for the bowlers as it will be difficult to bowl on this surface. Adds bowlers should look to bowl more cutters on this surface.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Tarisai Musakanda, Tinashe Kamunhukamwe, Sean Williams (C), Sikandar Raza, Richmond Mutumbami (WK), Wesley Madhevere, Ryan Burl, Donald Tiripano, Brandon Mavuta, Blessing Muzarabani, Richard Ngarava.

Afghanistan (Playing XI) - Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Karim Janat, Usman Ghani, Asghar Afghan (C), Hashmatullah Shahidi, Najibullah Zadran, Mohammad Nabi, Rashid Khan, Amir Hamza, Naveen-ul-Haq, Fareed Malik
TOSS TIME! The two captains are out in the middle. AFGHANISTAN HAVE WON THE TOSS AND ELECTED TO BAT FIRST.

Hello and welcome to the 2nd of the 3-match T20I series between Afghanistan and Zimbabwe. The hosts completely dominated the first game and would look to do more of the same in this one and seal the series. Zimbabwe, on the other hand, have a lot to work upon. They will be looking to put on a better display in all three departments and stay alive in the series. Can Zimbabwe find a way to upset Afghanistan or will the Asian side seal the series?
